description: List the action items: what to work on next on the workspace's own site: its product and service pages, searches Google shows it for that no page is about, problems across the whole site from the weekly crawl, and AI answers that contradict one of your facts (your fact and the engine; the answer's words are in list_brand_facts). Each item has the problem, its group (stops Google or AI, costs you clicks, or polish), its evidence lines with the numbers behind them, a suggested fix when there is one, and its one action. todo comes in the page's order; done holds finished and hidden items.
name: get_insights
